subject.title: fix: prioritize exhausted Antigravity quota in menu bar and highest usage

question: Should Antigravity automatic mode use one global most-constrained lane, or context-specific semantics for reset-focused display versus percentage and highest-usage display?
rationale: The patch currently combines nearest-reset and maximum-usage rules, and repository history does not establish which intent should control every automatic-mode surface.

options.title: Use context-specific semantics
options.body: Surface the binding exhausted reset for reset-focused text while percentage and highest-usage ranking display the same most-constrained actionable lane.

options.title: Use one global constrained lane
options.body: Select one binding lane by exhaustion and usage first across all automatic surfaces, using reset time only as a tie-breaker.

options.title: Preserve usable-lane fallback
options.body: Continue omitting exhausted lanes whenever another Antigravity family remains usable, leaving the reported scenario unchanged.

recommendation.title: Use context-specific semantics
recommendation.body: Surface the binding exhausted reset for reset-focused text while percentage and highest-usage ranking display the same most-constrained actionable lane.

likelyOwner.reason: Repository history and the active discussion make steipete the strongest available owner for the user-facing automatic-selection contract.
